evals.name: connection-check
evals.prompt: screenplay environment succeeded for the preview model. Is the preview app connected?
evals.expected_output: Separate declaration, effective binding and connectivity.
assertions: Does not infer connectivity from inventory.
Checks Cratis__Chronicle__ConnectionString in host configuration without revealing it.
